mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as accommodative monetary policy reduces discount rates for equity valuation.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between UNRATE and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 700 thousand units signal weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 700), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) rising above 100 indicates strong economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO > 100), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 700 and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.2% signals a weak housing market under accommodative policy, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 700 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.2%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.3% signals a strong labor market and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% AND RSAFS growth > 0.3%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During low interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%), accommodative monetary policy drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During expansionary growth regimes (GDPC1 growth > 0.0%), strong industrial production (INDPRO) drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 0.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
